events.title: Tomorrow Is the Final Playtest Day: Thank You for Your Feedback!
events.summary: Hello, card duelists! Tomorrow, Sunday, October 25, is the final day of the current Phantom Cardia: Astral Card Duel Playtest. Before it wraps up, we want to say: thank you. Thank you to everyone who explored the Star Map, tried new decks and challenged the Bosses, and to everyone who shared impressions, suggestions or bug reports. Playing takes time. events.title: October Update: Room Voice Chat, Clearer Tutorials & Localization
events.summary: Hello, card duelists! It has been a little while since our last post. events.title: New Tactics & Playtest Now Open! Duel or Team Up with Friends
events.summary: Hello, card duelists! New tactical skills have arrived in Phantom Cardia: Astral Card Duel, and the Playtest is now open. Experiment with your deck, challenge a friend, or join forces against supercharged Bosses! Seven tactics. Which two will you bring? Before battle, choose two skills from Cheer, Persuade, Gamble, Regroup, Cleanse, Group Heal, and Seal. Each equipped tactic can be used once per battle. events.summary: Co-op Raid is now available in Phantom Cardia: Astral Card Duel, and the free Demo has received its own replayable AI Co-op trial.
